# Shanon Raj’s Food Zone – Grab & Go App 🍗

A cross-platform food pre-order application powered by ROADYBITE.

## Features
- One-click food pre-order
- Grab & Go takeaway
- Zero waiting time
- UPI pre-payment (8088208835@ybl)
- WhatsApp order status notifications
- Auto-generated invoice
- Privacy protected
- Android & iOS support

## Menu
- Chicken Biryani – ₹100 (Serves 1)
- Max 6 items per order

## Order Flow
Preparing → Ready → Pick up

## Tech Stack
- HTML, CSS
- Capacitor (Android & iOS)
- Android Studio

## Build APK
```bash
npm install
npx cap add android
npx cap copy
npx cap open android
